text: We need to pick the event bus for events-pipeline before the dispatch rewrite. My vote is Kafka: we need to replay at least 7 days of events when a projection has a bug, and SQS can't do replay.
Agree on replay. Kinesis also has replay though?
It does, but 7-day retention on Kinesis costs more at our volume and none of us has run it. I ran Kafka in production for three years at my last job, and Lena has too, so we can operate it ourselves.
What peak are we sizing for?
Around 3k events/s at peak per the growth plan. A 3-broker cluster handles that with lots of headroom.
OK. Priya, can you write it up as an ADR so arch-review can sign off?
